high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "aboutislam.net," which appears to be discussing the Hajj pilgrimage in Islam. The content on the page explains that during the 'Arafah day, a pilgrim's main task is to stand (remain) at the site until the end of the day. This part of the Hajj is referred to as "al-wuquf bi 'Arafah" or "standing at 'Arafah." It also mentions that sometimes it is called "the day of 'Arafah (yawm 'arafah)," emphasizing the specific time and place associated
